title: The door carries every method kit to every host
summary: `@inventarch/runtime/method` reads method kits (releases format 1 and 2, bundled and IA home kits), selects a repository binding and resolves the method packet in process: the packet and digest the `ia` plugin prints. `ia-mcp-door` adds `ia_session`, `ia_catalogue` and `ia_method`, reads kits from `--kits` or `IA_KITS_DIR` and the IA home, acts at its root or a root the format 2 `workspace-locations.json` registry lists (both earlier formats are read), and restores a kit in process with the language base it now carries. `ia host <claude|codex|copilot> --commit` writes a committable bootstrap: an instruction block naming `ia_session` and the three lanes, and an `ia` MCP server running `npx -y @inventarch/mcp-door@<version>`. The position packet gains the session line. A GitHub Copilot host row is added and Codex hooks are marked supported. Workspace projections render one skill per invocable `@capability`, not one per `@playbook`. `ia host claude --user` installs `ia@inventarch` from `inventarch/marketplace`; `--local` keeps the rendered plugin. `config.json` names `accountOffer` beside `updateCheck`. The default public kits reach that door as the npm package `@inventarch/public-kits` (contract C7): `ia host <host> --commit` writes the door entry `npx -y -p @inventarch/mcp-door@<version> -p @inventarch/public-kits@<version> ia-mcp-door --kits-package @inventarch/public-kits` and records the package as one `package` entry in `.ia/distributions.lock.json` (its version, npm integrity and kits, from `npm view`, or `--kits-package-version`); nothing is vendored. The distribution lock engine moves to 0.1.2, which reads such entries; a lock without one is read and written byte for byte as before, under the 0.1.1 marker, and archives keep declaring `^0.1.1`. An engine from 0.1.2 on refuses a lock it cannot read naming the `ia` that can (`It needs ia >= 3.5.0`), and an unknown entry kind is refused, never ignored; 3.4 and earlier refuse a lock with entries as a contract error. The method resolver, `ia restore`, `ia validate` and the door treat the kits an entry names as installed once the package's `package.json` `ia.kits`, kit folders and npm install record match the entry, read from `--kits-package`, `IA_KITS_PACKAGE` or the workspace's `node_modules`; drift refuses naming the field, a kit neither vendored nor named is still refused, and `ia_session` reports default kits not installed when the package is absent. `ia validate --verify-conformance --require-verified` (opt-in) exits 1 unless COMP-KERNEL and COMP-FIXTURES are verified passes.
